title: Fund highlights per-CIK wrapper for concept mapping and share class aliases

xbrl_concept_substring.description: Lowercase substring matched against local XBRL concept name

target_field.description: Target highlights column name (e.g. assets_net, total_assets)

action.description: map=alias, suppress=ignore concept, prefer=override global priority

concept_overrides.description: Ordered concept-to-field overrides applied before the global HIGHLIGHTS_CONCEPT_MAP

share_class_aliases.description: Raw XBRL member substring -> canonical class label. Applied before global regex chain.

source_preferences.description: Per-field source preference when cross-source values diverge

notes.description: Free-text notes on why this wrapper exists

income_concept_suppress.description: Lower-case concept-name substrings the fund-income extractor (pipeline/bdc_fund_income.py) must not read as an income figure for this filer. For a filer whose own per-share concept contains an income concept's name and is filed ahead of the dollar fact (Monroe Capital Income Plus: mcip:NetInvestmentIncomePerShareDiluted 0.31 ahead of us-gaap:NetInvestmentIncome 27,547,000). Evidence required: the two facts of one period and the printed income statement line. Read by nothing else; the highlights extractor is not affected.

income_concept_fallback.description: Per income column, the whole lower-case concept names the fund-income extractor (pipeline/bdc_fund_income.py) may take for it where a period has an income statement and no fact for that column. For a filer that tags the figure under a concept the extractor does not read (Monroe Capital Income Plus, first-quarter 10-Qs and most 10-Qs from 2024: expenses only as InvestmentCompanyExpenseAfterReductionOfFeeWaiverAndReimbursement). A period that already has the column is never changed. Evidence required: the fact, and the printed income statement lines showing that total investment income less it is the filed net investment income.

figure_corrections.description: Fund-level figures the filing page states and the filer's undimensioned facts get wrong, miss, or file at the wrong scale. Applied to the company-facts balance frame before scale detection. Each needs the printed evidence.
